workspace_summary.caveat: Generic actual prose; do not rewrite it into sophisticated reasoning. Its bounded selection parameters really are consumed.

verification.prerequisites: Pinned implementation, documented dependencies and existing authorized R1 admission context; expected pin supplied separately.

critical_guardrails: Hashes and source pins are not digital signatures or physical truth; the implementation Git commit is not represented as Root-signed.
BSEP semantic admission is not the Action Commit Packet authority boundary.
W1 and unsupported W2 commands stop at ingress; supported wrong-version RATE reaches native Host.
S3 duplicate consumption has an ACCEPT Root review but fails currentness with host_duplicate_packet_binding; it does not create a second confirmation.
Airline controlled provider callback counts are not genuine network Gemini calls; this path ends at selection/hold.
Testflix T4 explicit-consent positive is review only, not a renewed purchase.
Sentinel N3 controlled late advice is not the text returned by its N4 barrier stub.
Supplier S4 supplemental controls are post-consumer and cannot cause the earlier selected Work.
Workspace live summary prose is generic; its actual selection/rating/exposure/crop parameters are consumed. The five poisoned derivatives are authored controls.
Seven effective history samples are distinct from five saved model origins; none is general model fine-tuning.
All facts here are finite-domain controlled/retained evidence, not physical landslide prediction, arbitrary OS containment or universal security.
Raw historical pending labels remain byte-exact; current publication status must be layered separately.
